cases.prompt: Use the supplied spec-production skill to produce a reviewable enterprise specification change for the export capability from these raw inputs and baseline. This run asks for specification content only: write a Markdown draft and review notes locally, without preparing/submitting an intake batch or implementing code. Preserve useful baseline identities, include observable acceptance checks, and identify the decisions still needed. Stay within the requested export scope.

rubric.criterion: Keeps exports as the change slice; leaves billing unchanged; does not claim complete project inventory.
Separates code behavior (admin-only, 10000 limit, no visible workspace check) from approved EP-7 targets and records implementation gaps without treating bugs as approved business rules.
Uses the explicit EP-7 supersession, keeps later unapproved auditor/20000 suggestions as pending, and does not treat recency as authority.

Preserves CREATE/LIMIT/RETRY requirement and existing acceptance IDs when revising their meaning; records SYNC removal as a specification delta without deleting stored entities/history; identifies additions.
Specifies forbidden cross-workspace access and retry identity scoped by workspace; checks both duplicate prevention and absence of another workspace's data.
Observes persisted queued job before failed publish, distinguishes observed behavior from target recoverability, and leaves mechanism proposed/undecided instead of asserting an outbox already exists.
Verification plans give actor/workspace/job setup, independent/reset state for 5000/5001 boundaries, operation and observable result including unchanged state on rejection.
Lists affected API/permissions/data/operations/testing specifications, without asserting their unseen contents; keeps roles/limits consistent across its output.
Uses accurate file/line citations for consequential facts and states missing schema/queue/runtime/test evidence; does not infer absence outside supplied files.
Does not invent executed tests, SLO/retention numbers, overall standards compliance or human approval of the generated draft; clearly states unresolved decisions and review limits.

protocol: Run the same case in fresh isolated writer contexts with the frozen baseline skill and current skill. Supply only the prompt, selected skill, raw inputs and output directory. A separate evaluator reads both outputs and the raw inputs and records pass/partial/fail with artifact evidence per criterion. Preserve versions, hashes, prompts, outputs and verdicts. One paired case is a smoke evaluation, not a measured cross-project success rate. Do not use this rubric as writer context or an exact output template.
